payload.reason: The evidence provides specific details about previously reported results in speculation detection using transformer-based architectures, including improvements in F1 scores over prior work.

claims.text: Substantial improvements were reported over previously reported results by at least 0.29 F1 points on cue detection and 4.27 F1 points on scope resolution.
XLNet consistently outperforms BERT and RoBERTa in the context of negation detection and scope resolution, contrary to results on other benchmark datasets.
State-of-the-art results were achieved on negation scope resolution for the BioScope Corpus with an increase of 3.16 F1 points on the BioScope Full Papers.
